title: OpenAI commits to buy an extra $250B of Microsoft Azure cloud services

sources.quote: OpenAI has contracted to purchase an incremental $250B of Azure services, and Microsoft will no longer have a right of first refusal to be OpenAI’s compute provider.
Under the new agreement, OpenAI has contracted to purchase an incremental $250 billion of Azure services, and Microsoft will no longer have a right of first refusal to be OpenAI's compute provider.

explain: When OpenAI restructured into a for-profit public benefit corporation in October 2025, it signed a new deal with Microsoft promising to buy another $250 billion of Azure cloud computing. In return Microsoft gave up its right to be first in line for OpenAI's new computing needs.
